question: What workload information may an agent inspect: only its own session and spawned descendants, anonymized global lane capacity, or raw cross-agent queue/session details?
rationale: The queue data exists, but repository policy does not define whether operational workload metadata is private per agent, globally visible, or operator-only; that choice determines the tool schema, authorization checks, and reusable API boundary.

options.title: Scoped agent view
options.body: Expose the caller's own and descendant workload with anonymized global lane counts, withholding unrelated agent and session identifiers.

options.title: Operator-wide view
options.body: Expose raw lanes and per-agent/session workload only to an explicit privileged tool policy or operator capability.

options.title: Operator diagnostics only
options.body: Keep workload snapshots out of agent tools and expose them solely through authenticated CLI, RPC, or Control UI diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Scoped agent view
recommendation.body: Expose the caller's own and descendant workload with anonymized global lane counts, withholding unrelated agent and session identifiers.

likelyOwner.reason: The queue and agent-tool boundaries have substantial history under this contributor, including the original queue implementation and recent gateway/tool maintenance.
